meta.name: api-error-handling
meta.description: Implement comprehensive API error handling with standardized error responses, logging, monitoring, retry logic, and validation patterns. Use when building resilient APIs, debugging issues, improving error reporting, implementing retry logic, handling HTTP error codes, managing API timeouts, designing error response handling, or adding circuit breaker patterns.

copy.tagline: 为 API 添加标准化的错误处理、重试与监控
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在构建或维护需要高可靠性的 API 服务
copy.tagline_en: Add standardized error handling, retry logic, and monitoring to your APIs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build or maintain APIs that need high reliability and resilience

howto.what: 当Claude编写API代码时，它会生成标准化的错误处理结构，包括统一的错误响应格式（含错误代码、状态码、请求ID等）、自定义错误类、日志级别建议、重试逻辑和断路器模式，以及输入验证代码。
howto.when: 当你要求构建稳健的API、调试问题、改进错误报告、实现重试逻辑、处理HTTP错误码、管理超时、设计错误响应或添加断路器模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成统一API错误响应格式的中间件。
say.note: Claude会提供错误响应格式代码和全局错误处理中间件。

say.text: 添加指数退避重试和断路器。
say.note: Claude会生成重试策略与断路器实现。

say.text: 为我的API实现输入验证和错误收集。

howto.what_en: When writing API code, Claude will generate standardized error handling structures including uniform error response format (with error code, status code, request ID, etc.), custom error classes, logging level suggestions, retry logic, circuit breaker pattern, and input validation code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build resilient APIs, debug issues, improve error reporting, implement retry logic, handle HTTP error codes, manage timeouts, design error responses, or add circuit breaker patterns.

say_en.text: Generate a unified API error response format middleware.
say_en.note: Claude will provide error response code and global middleware.

say_en.text: Add exponential backoff retry and circuit breaker.
say_en.note: Claude will generate retry strategy and circuit breaker code.

say_en.text: Implement input validation and error collection for my API.
say_en.note: Claude will produce validation pattern code.
